text:
amanda: Noticed a cluster onboarding regression in us-east-2. ~30 GPU nodes stuck in 'provisioning' with keystore decryption errors.
raj: Error snippet from node logs: `failed to decrypt /etc/keystore: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt`
kevin: Any recent IAM policy changes? We pushed an org-wide conditional that requires `aws:ResourceTag/keystore=enabled` to access the keystore role last week.
sanjay: Right 3 we rolled that to reduce blast radius. But the warm-pool ASGs don't propagate tags to instance profiles (PropagateAtLaunch=false). New nodes have no resource tag so conditional denies.
amanda: Bingo. That matches: ASG membership shows tags on ASG but instances lack `keystore=enabled`.
opsbot: Alert: keystore-decrypt-errors > 3% in us-east-2 for 10m. CI jobs impacted: 6.
kevin: Short-term mitigation: create a temporary role-policy that allows kms:Decrypt for the warm-pool instance profile principal in us-east-2 only. Add TTL and approval.
raj: We should also update the ASG launch template to propagate tags, but that requires staged rollout.
sec-bot: Note: Any temporary policy must be attested and logged. Attach the approval ticket #INFRA-4821.
amanda: Proposed commands: 
```
# add propagation
aws autoscaling create-or-update-tags --tags ResourceId=gpu-warm-templates,ResourceType=launch-template,PropagateAtLaunch=true,Key=keystore,Value=enabled
# temp role attach
aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name warmpool-keystore-relax-us-east-2 --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::012345678901:policy/KeystoreDecryptTemp
```
kevin: I'll stand up the temp role and scope it by condition `StringEquals: {aws:RequestedRegion: "us-east-2"}` and expiry in 2 hours. Post change, throttle warm-pool parallel joins to avoid KMS QPS burst.
raj: Also switch audit exporter sampling to 15% for the region during remediation to avoid natgw saturation. Security OK with sampled logs for 2 hours?
sec-bot: Approved with note: sample rate must be documented and retained for compliance. Attach attestation once done.
opsbot: Change executed: temp-role created, audit-sample=15% (us-east-2), join-throttle=4. Monitoring enabled.
amanda: Seeing keystore decrypt success rate rising. Node join backlog shrinking.
sanjay: Follow-up tasks: 1) update launch template to PropagateAtLaunch=true for all warm-pool templates 2) remove temp-role after SLO stable 3) postmortem + security attestation 4) add CI test that simulates tag propagation during ASG launch.
kevin: Cost note: reducing audit sample from 100% to 15% will reduce egress and S3 put costs; estimate ~1.2TB saved/hour in region (~$100). Add to the incident cost section.
amanda: Creating INFRA-4821/PM draft now; will include exact bytes and policy diffs.
raj: Also let's add a health check in the autoscaler pre-hook: fail scale if instance lacks `keystore=enabled` tag. Prevents half-baked nodes joining.
sec-bot: Reminder: any permanent change to tagging or policy must pass compliance review. Looping product-compliance.
opsbot: Monitoring: will auto-close temp-role when decrypt-error < 0.2% for 30m or after 2 hours.
amanda: Thanks team, good catch. Will follow up with PRs for launch-template and the automation test.
